construction_revision.maintenance_rationale: A report contains parent-only and consolidated statements with superficially similar starting labels. An audit must preserve tax and ownership scopes across three linked reconciliations and resist equating unrealized earnings, sale gains and float stocks with cash flows.

public_definitions.parent_earnings_bridge: After-tax parent scope for three years. Parent income is the sum of the disclosed after-tax parent earnings components. Operating earnings remove signed investment gains and signed equity-method impairments from that sum. Residual is the component sum less independently reported parent income.
public_definitions.consolidated_cash_bridge: Consolidated scope for three years. Parent income retains the independently reported parent amount, rather than the component sum in parent_earnings_bridge. Add all signed statement adjustments to consolidated net earnings. Noncontrolling income is consolidated less reported parent income.

public_definition_addenda.consolidated_cash_bridge: residual_usd_million is reconstructed operating cash flow less independently reported operating cash flow.
public_definition_addenda.investment_gain_bridge: cash_removal_residual_usd_million is net pretax investment gain components plus the signed cash-flow statement adjustment for investment gains.
